overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on multilingual instruction-following evaluation using both human and GPT-4-based assessment. The main contributions include creating parallel datasets (Lima-X, MT-Bench-X) and studying multilingual instruction-tuning effects. The experimental setup is comprehensive with clear evaluation protocols.
